motivation: Fraction-of-all-miss budgets can hide the warm-state transition's value. Sweep margins relative to the compulsory-miss lower bound uniformly, rather than selecting a single favorable deadline.
design: same79 architecture configurations in sensitivity_protocol.json, unchanged families and boundaries
budget: C + q*Lm + (n-q)*Lh + slack, where q lines are initially cold and all n reads use only those lines; infinity provides this analysis bound with no switches
release: all policies receive zero-cost clean release at reader completion
fixed_control: all255 loads times all four subsets of boundaries1,2 to clean-flush at zero cost; flush resets analysis. This is an optimistic counterfactual capability, not implemented HUSH hardware.
phase_control: 343 phase paths from {1,4,16,32,64,254,255}^3 plus every exact fixed path; no boundary flush
reset_ablation: same physical phase paths, discard analysis state only when the selected load changes
selection: minimize makespan at phi0 under each budget; retain every point, ties and regressions against the stronger fixed control
validation: check all predicted hits and program bounds, same service and payload assertions as the execution model
scope: synthetic architectural study; no application or wall-clock performance claim
